name: momentum-lab-desktop
description: Momentum Lab — desktop application (Electron + React + FastAPI).
author: Momentum Lab

scripts.dev-app:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development MRP_DEV_APP=1 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace renderer run typecheck && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:electron && node scripts/backend-manager.test.cjs && node scripts/startup-trace.test.cjs && node scripts/paths.test.cjs && node scripts/release-validation.test.cjs && node scripts/electron-updater-import.test.cjs && node scripts/no-secret-exposure.test.cjs
